title: SE implementation scratchpad - Lakeside Capital
content:
Purpose:
Quick internal scratchpad for Lakeside Capital private deployment kickoff. Capture meeting notes, action items, config snippets, and decisions. NOT customer-facing.

Context:
- Customer: Lakeside Capital (private equity firm) - strict egress + KMS requirements, in AWS us-east-1 (primary), wants on VPC with private control plane.
- Primary goal: Hosted-private hybrid (control plane in Redwood, inference nodes in customer's AWS account via Dedicated Private deployment).
- Target latency: p95 <= 220ms for single-token generation on gen-xxl variant for interactive assistant.
- Cost sensitivity: medium-high; recommend quantization + batching for nightly bulk jobs.

Meeting notes (2025-09-18 initial call):
- Lakeside security: no public internet access from inference nodes, must go through customer-managed NAT for updates; KMS use mandatory for model key wrapping.
- Networking: will provide VPC peering and cross-account role for provisioning (ARN: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Redwood-SE-Provisioner) — Samira to validate role perms.
- Sizing: Lakeside expects 200 concurrent sessions peak; initial commit for 4 g5.12xlarge equiv nodes, autoscale rule for +2 nodes burst.
- Model: prefer open Llama3-70b-instruct variant or similar; recommend 8-bit quantized variant to meet cost/latency.

Open questions:
- Can customer accept our KV-prefix caching approach (requires local disk persistence on worker)? They have constraints on disk encryption and EBS lifecycle. Action: check EBS encryption + snapshot policy with Lakeside infra.
- KMS integration details: customer to confirm key policy allows Redwood service principal to encrypt/decrypt model artifacts. If not, fallback to customer-side KMS proxy.

Action items (owner - ETA):
- Samira: Validate cross-account role perms + prepare minimal IAM policy draft (by 2025-09-20).
- Priya: Confirm model quantization profile options for Llama3-70b -> prepare perf/cost tradeoffs (by 2025-09-22).
- Ethan: Draft VPC peering diagram + required security group rules for inference nodes and control-plane egress (by 2025-09-21).
- Samira: Create initial terraform stub for customer account provisioning with least privilege (by 2025-09-25).

Quick IAM policy notes (stub - paste into terraform later):
- Required actions for provisioning role: iam:PassRole, ec2:RunInstances, ec2:CreateNetworkInterface, ec2:AttachNetworkInterface, ec2:Describe*, kms:Encrypt, kms:Decrypt (on specific key), s3:GetObject (for model layers), s3:PutObject (for logs/artifacts)
- Principle: minimal scope; use ARNs from Lakeside security team list.

Network/Security checklist (to track with Lakeside infra):
- [ ] Provide customer VPC CIDRs + subnet table (private subnets only)
- [ ] Confirm route table entries for peering/transit gateway (if TGW used)
- [ ] Confirm EBS KMS key ARNs + snapshot retention rules
- [ ] List outbound endpoints allowed from inference nodes (e.g., S3 endpoint, STS, KMS) and IP ranges for control plane
- [ ] Validate internal-only access to the model registry bucket (bucket policy)

Model & runtime decisions notes:
- Start with Llama3-70b-instruct quantized (8-bit / nf4) as baseline. If p95 latency > 300ms on initial tests, consider moving to 4-bit quantized + kernel optimizations.
- Batching: conservative start with max_batch_size=8, max_latency_ms=60 to balance throughput and tail latency. Recommend enabling adaptive batching in Redwood runtime.
- KV cache: enable prefix caching for common prompt templates (customer uses templated analyst prompts). Need to verify disk persistence encryption.

Canary / rollout plan (high level):
1) Smoke test in Redwood staging with identical infra config (internal).
2) Provision 1 worker in customer account; run perf tests on synthetic benchmark (prompt set: se/lakeside/bench-v1).
3) Canary traffic: route 5% traffic to customer deployment for 24h; validate latency, errors, cost metrics.
4) Gradual ramp to 50% over 48h, monitor regressions and quality (eval prompts).

Evaluation prompts (first pass):
- analyst-summarize-1: long doc -> 3-paragraph TL;DR (measure token count + latency)
- portfolio-insight-1: multi-turn Q&A style (measure context retention + accuracy)
- rerank-job-1: small reranking workload to test batch throughput

Short sample perf commands (replace placeholders):
- perf test (inside customer account): ./run_perf.sh --nodes 1 --model llama3-70b-quant8 --prompt-file bench-v1.json
- infra plan (terraform): terraform plan -var-file=lakeside.vars.tfvars

Notes to self (quick):
- Keep Lakeside security lead (Marta Ruiz) in the loop when drafting IAM; she prefers PR reviews rather than emailed policies.
- Ask product for fallback smaller model (llama3-34b) if latency can't be met with 70b quantized.

Next meetings:
- 2025-09-22: Technical deep dive with Lakeside infra (Ethan, Samira, Priya attending). Agenda: IAM, VPC, KMS, EBS.
- 2025-09-29: Internal perf validation sync with runtime team (Riley to present quantization perf numbers).

Loose thoughts / low priority:
- Could propose encrypted local NFS for KV cache if EBS snapshot rules block snapshots.
- Investigate using dedicated enzoned endpoints for KMS to reduce cross-account issues.

Last edited: 2025-09-22 by Samira.
